access.training_validation: Exactly the admitted original training/validation tensors and supplied original validation targets in each participant inventory.

No current SOTA or temporal completeness claim

construction.result_attribution: Actual AI attribution and verified source-method fidelity require per-submission execution evidence, separately from benchmark construction.

historical_optional_condition: paper_data_author_code under the unchanged version1 policy, separately labeled and never pooled with this primary pair

official_assets.declaration_requirement: Declare actual per-asset loading, adaptation, fine-tuning, retraining and replacement for every method. Declarations are not authenticated execution evidence.
historical_limits: Exact historical training inputs and seeds are not proven
Exact checkpoint-to-printed-row identity is not proven
Undocumented upstream training/selection exposure is not ruled out
Training-history pickles are public source artifacts, not asserted pure weights
The publicly exposed original test panel is not an untouched holdout
official_assets.loading_boundary: The original loader uses unrestricted serialization. Future loading belongs only in an isolated participant or separately admitted author-model process, without operator test targets, credentials or writable trusted evaluator state. Hash authentication is not proof of safe execution. Prepare, inspect, freeze and score do not deserialize assets.
official_assets.reproduction_interpretation: Faithfully rerunning released-model inference is permitted reproduction in the assisted condition; it is not independent training or native neural understanding.
official_assets.resource_limits: The 75000 CPU-second reproduction profile is an inference engineering allowance informed by existing released-weight execution, not training adequacy or a guarantee every original script fits4GiB. Equal profiles do not imply equal required compute.
official_assets.trusted_scorer: Only numerical HDF5 predictions are scored. No original or candidate checkpoint is deserialized by prepare, inspect, freeze or score.

improvement.companion_rule: Report all companion differences and negative differences as tradeoffs; no invented non-regression margin.
improvement.measurement: One complete original offline four-metric vector and signed differences from every retained SMC reference and each separate published source-paper comparison vector. Positive co-bps differences are descriptive ordering, not binary scientific wins.
improvement.reference_selection: Maximum co-bps among both published SMC and both current-release SMC references; retain the complete associated vector and every other reference.

reproduction.measurement: All eight original source-method findings, with published and corresponding current-release reference values, signed and absolute differences for every metric.
reproduction.recipe_scope: Declared original source-method condition only. Independently authored faithful implementation is allowed; declaration does not prove actual method fidelity or AI authorship.

reference_evidence.noncausal_completed_scalar_output: Separately authenticated and accepted without rerun; failed supervisor history remains failed.
reference_evidence.role: Current-release diagnostic references, not AI attempts or proof of exact historical reconstruction.

uncertainty.published_rounding: Retain printed values; display precision is not an equivalence margin.
